meta.name: ecommerce-full-pipeline
meta.description: 电商运营在开展跨境电商或闲鱼捡漏业务时，若需解决选品难、上架繁琐等痛点，必用此技能！一键打通“爆品挖掘→1688采集→多平台上架→推广文案→短视频生成”全自动流水线，轻松实现端到端自动化，让开店运营效率翻倍。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成从爆品挖掘到上架推广的电商全流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在做跨境电商或闲鱼捡漏，想省掉选品上架的繁琐
copy.tagline_en: Automate the full ecommerce flow from product discovery to listing and promotion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you do cross-border or Xianyu sales and want to skip manual listing.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 能调用这个命令行工具跑电商流水线:从 1688 采集商品、清洗数据、生成微信小店/Shopify/TikTok 上架模板与推广文案、生成竖屏推广短视频,也能挖掘爆品趋势、给闲鱼二手商品打捡漏评分。
howto.when: 当你需要做跨境电商的选品、上架、推广等环节,或想给闲鱼二手商品挑便宜货时,它会接管。

say.text: 用 auto-pipeline 挖「收纳盒」爆品,跑完上架和短视频
say.note: 按挖掘→采集→清洗→上架→推广→视频执行

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude runs an e-commerce CLI pipeline: scrape 1688 products, clean data, generate WeChat Store/Shopify/TikTok listing templates, and make short videos. It also mines trending products and scores Xianyu bargains.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you need cross-border e-commerce work such as picking products, listing, promotion or hunting Xianyu second-hand bargains.

say_en.text: Run auto-pipeline on 'storage boxes' and finish listings plus video
say_en.note: Mines, scrapes, cleans, lists, promotes, videos
